verdict: Matches the tooling (Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, LLMs, fine-tuning with QLoRA/LoRA and for retrieval, embedding benchmarking on 1M+ chunks, evaluation pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI) and NLP-adjacent production work (LLM extraction from documents). The posting is research-heavy and the team is "small senior"; risk that 3 years reads junior for them.
